title: German Cabbage Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew featuring tender cabbage and a rich creamy sauce.

ingredients.name: stew
ingredients.notes: you can use vegetable broth for a vegetarian option

ingredients.name: numbing
ingredients.notes: optional, for added depth of flavor

instructions: In a large pot, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped cabbage and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the german seasoning blend, caraway seeds, and beef broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
